rows.en: Many worlds, many universes...
They existed in separate space-times, called parallel worlds,
and were never meant to intersect.
Yes... until that day came.
The Great Spacequake...
A massive spacequake in one world
shattered the dimensional walls separating the worlds.
Thus, countless parallel worlds merged with one another,
and many new worlds were born.
This was the birth of the multiverse.
The birth of new worlds brought new encounters,
and new encounters brought new battles. Many
multiverses remained in chaos long after their birth.
Yet in some of them, a new order gradually began
to emerge.
The worlds known as UCW and ADW
and many other worlds had merged to create an Earth...
There, the alien Geminids' dimensional wall
had sealed the Earth away, turning it into the Time Prison.
Within it, the brave stood together with their comrades
and kept fighting to change the world.
Everyone's hopes for the future became one,
and the Time Prison was destroyed.
Though many mysteries remained,
the warriors savored their victory, won through hardship.
The shattered Time Prison was proof. With their own eyes,
they were about to confirm it.
Yet this was the beginning of a new battle...
The Interstellar Military Alliance, Sidereal...
From beyond the dimensional wall they came, bearing that name,
and launched an invasion of the entire Earth.
Their forces, sent from another Earth,
used overwhelming force on the spent Earth Federation forces,
and trampled them underfoot.
Within two months of the war's outbreak, 75% of Earth
had fallen under Sidereal's control.
Under the name of Emperor Australis, they
founded the New Earth Empire (Gaia Empire),
with its imperial capital, Wrath Babylon, at its apex.
They set up strategic Terminal Bases across their territory,
linking them with paths of light called Leylines.
It was as though the planet Earth had been covered
by a web of light.
With their chain of command severed, the Earth Federation forces
could only resist separately, and their fate
hung by a thread.
But even so, they never gave up;
even now, for their beliefs and what they had to protect,
they fought on...
With fighting in the Earth Sphere over, humanity's greatest enemy
was Baal, nesting at the center of the galaxy.
One month after the battle with the ELS had ended...
Humanity pushed ahead with its long-planned
"Absolute Earth Defense Plan" at a rapid pace,
and a fleet to annihilate Baal at the galaxy's center
was being readied for dispatch.
To honor the great contribution to the project's progress
of a certain parallel world,
the fleet would come to be known as...
the Galactic Assault Fleet...
The Heavenly Pillar in the galactic core pierces all parallel worlds.
Beyond it lies the universe of the Angels.
Chaos Cosmos...
There lies the true battlefield, drawing in every parallel world.
What, then, awaits humanity at the end of that battle...?
Beyond the Heavenly Prison...
What will humankind see at the end of the myth...?
Earth Federation forces: 34.8% of founding strength remaining.
The chain of command is disrupted.
Enemy Sidereal: strength, organization size, all else unknown.
Breaching absolute defense lines on all fronts, the enemy fleet
descended toward Earth.
It was the beginning of a new battle...
the beginning of a battle without end.
While Blue Earth was trapped in the Time Prison,
a battle was taking place at the galaxy's center.
The Galactic Alliance of Humankind and the Hideauze...
Their fight for survival had lasted since the distant past,
and even now, there was no end in sight...
By the Primordial Singularity and the Quarreling Twins' Sphere,
the people's wishes were gathered at the Super Singularity.
As a result, the Multidimensional World was restored.
The cosmos and people returned to a pre-Great Spacequake world.
It was the beginning of a new world and era...
the dawn of the Hyperdimensional World.
Before the overwhelming military might of the New Earth Empire,
Earth's defenders found themselves at a disadvantage.
Across conquered lands, the Empire planned strategic hubs...
facilities later known as Terminal Bases,
which it intended to build...
As the New Earth Empire's attacks continued across the world,
Japan remained relatively peaceful.
But behind the scenes, sharpening its fangs for its own desires,
was a certain group...
After discovering his family's secret late in the Time Prison War,
Riddhe Marcenas, to escape the fate binding him and Audrey,
had come to regard the Unicorn Gundam's very existence
with hatred.
Sensing the uneasy mood within the ranks, Bright Noa turned to
the Tuatha de Danaan, sailing alone for Axis, entrusting the matter
entirely to a certain person aboard...
Some two weeks into the New Earth Empire's invasion of Earth.
As the Earth Federation Forces kept losing across the world,
Japan was enjoying relatively peaceful days.
But in the shadows, an organization had begun to move...
The New Earth Empire's attacks left Earth's defenders outmatched.
With command split, the Federation kept losing worldwide,
and the front depended on its surviving troops and local resistance
fighting with all their strength...
After capturing the Terminal Base at Neo Alcatraz,
the group had gained new allies.
Before their assault on the imperial capital, Wrath Babylon,
they each spent the time as they wished...
As the New Earth Empire closed in on New Japan,
Zero rallied the citizens' strength and formed a volunteer army.
Yet he harbored a worry.
Just how long could the people endure the fighting?
Zero devised a plan to bring smiles back to New Japan...
With the assault on Wrath Babylon just one day away,
the group, pledging victory in their hearts, shared a modest feast
and enjoyed themselves...
As the New Earth Empire dispatched troops far and wide,
survivors of shattered Federation units stayed in those areas,
forming resistance forces and continuing the fight.
Still struggling, they trusted a certain rumor to sustain
their fighting spirit, which was close to breaking...
Near the end of UCW's Multiverse War, ZEUTH
had joined forces with the Archangel, but
past events had left some of their members
divided by an invisible wall.
Even after ZEUTH disbanded, those tensions
continued to linger in their relationships...
The New Earth Empire's rule of Earth centered on Terminal Bases,
consisting of isolated strongpoints.
As a result, areas outside the bases' jurisdiction
were relatively free of the Empire's influence.
In places like these, the people continued with resilience
to live their lives, even today...
Barbiel the Needle had abducted Suzune Saijou. To gather
information on him, the group chose to assault the Terminal Base
under Sardias Ax's control.
But a major obstacle stood in their way...
After Suzune Saijou, even Setsuko Ohara
had been abducted from the group by Barbiel the Needle.
The emotional shock cast a dark shadow
over the entire unit...
Having taken in the people of Kugel's fleet after they lost Striker,
the Gargantia Fleet
had regained its vitality under the new fleet commander, Ridget.
But peace was still a long way off...
When the Multiverse War ended and the Executor's threat passed,
Loran Cehack had a plan for a relic of the Black History,
the White Doll: in Vicinity's Mountain Cycle,
he would bury it.
Yet deep within the Mountain Cycle,
a darkness still lay hidden, unknown to them...
Nono, who had been working part-time on Green Earth,
had been taken by Lal'C Mellk Mal and Nicola Vacheron
to Meganebula,
the Fraternity's base.
Besides them, another Topless was there:
Tycho Science...
Sousuke Sagara had gained a new power, ARX-8 Laevatein,
and reunited with his partner, Al.
But the fight against Amalgam, whose intentions were still unclear,
was placing a heavy strain on their minds.
Then, one night, an incident occurred...
After returning from Green Earth to Blue Earth, the group
split into three units, each carrying out its own mission.
Graham Aker, Patrick Mannequin,
and Zechs Marquise were on a mission to keep Neo Zeon in check.
They headed toward a civilian shuttle sending a distress signal
to rescue it...
Having learned Chrono's doctrine and humanity's true history,
as fervor for a decisive clash with the New Earth Empire grew,
Roger Smith still had one question
on his mind...
The New Earth Empire's defeat and mutual understanding with ELS
were achieved by the people of Earth.
The battles since the Time Prison War seemed at an end,
but peace was still far away...
The New Earth Empire's defeat and mutual understanding with ELS
were achieved by the people of Earth.
Amid the brief calm, the group looked toward further battles,
their fighting spirit burning anew...
The New Earth Empire's defeat and mutual understanding with ELS
were achieved by the people of Earth.
Amid the brief calm, the group looked toward further battles,
their fighting spirit burning anew...
The New Earth Empire's defeat and mutual understanding with ELS
were achieved by the people of Earth.
As preparations for the next battle advanced,
Solarian had arrived at the colonists' residential district on Mars...
Having achieved Shinka Fusion, the group
traveled Chaos Cosmos, the universe where the Angels live.
Enemies far beyond anything they could imagine
lay in wait ahead, and the group knew it...

concluding_narration.en: It was the beginning of a new battle...
the beginning of a battle without end.

rows.text: 1. Battle Changes
2. Z Crystal
3. Tag Battle System
4. Tag Battle Combat
5. SR Points
6. Spirit Points
7. Quick Save
8. Tag Tension 1
9. Tag Tension 2
10. Tactical Combo
11. Retry
12. Song System
13. D Commands
14. Shinka
●Main additions and changes to the battle system in this game
1. Tag Commands: Adds the new Tag Command 1Boost Dash1.
Using Boost Dash increases movement by 5 and
ignores movement penalties from terrain.
You can also move even if enemy teams
surround your team on all four sides.
2. Tactical Combo: In Jigoku-hen, when an allied team finished its action,
the Combo Gauge dropped if it had not destroyed
an enemy team, decreasing by 1.
In this game, after using the unit commands Maximum Break,
Attack or Song, if you fail to completely destroy an enemy team,
the Combo Gauge drops by 1. However,
1Repair, Resupply, and Move (followed by Wait)1
1do not decrease the Combo Gauge1.
3. Maximum Break: In Jigoku-hen, if both the main and sub units
used ALL weapons during Maximum Break,
and the sub unit's attack destroyed only the enemy main unit,
combat ended at that point.
In this game, even under the same circumstances,
combat continues 1if the enemy sub unit remains1,
and your main unit attacks next.
4. Erosion: A special weapon effect possessed by some enemies.
When a mech takes damage from this weapon,
its main pilot 1loses 10 Focus1.
After combat, if the affected pilot's Focus
is 80 or below, the mech is treated as
destroyed, regardless of its HP.
●A new menu added to 1D-Trader1 during intermission.
●In Z Crystal, you can spend 1Z Chips1 to upgrade the Z Crystal,
and 1your entire squad gains various effects depending on its upgrade level1.
●The Z Crystal has a GRADE ranging from 0 to 5,
and grants more effects as its GRADE increases.
●GRADE 0 (its initial state) has no effects. The effects begin
at GRADE 1.
GRADE 4 and GRADE 5 each offer three effects. When upgrading,
you choose one of them. You cannot change the effect after confirming it.
●A battle system in which you fight in teams of two units.
●Two units form a Tag, and one unit forms a Single. Both are called teams.
●Set up teams during intermission. You 1cannot split or merge them on the map1.
You can freely switch the main and sub units.
●A team's movement is the 1average of its units' movement, rounded up1.
●A team can enter map terrain (air or ground) only if
every unit in the team can enter that terrain.
●Single Attack: Only the main unit attacks.
This also applies when you use an ALL weapon to attack every enemy unit.
When using an ALL weapon against a team of two units,
attack power is 1multiplied by 0.751.
●Center Attack: Your sub and main units attack one unit in the enemy team.
The sub unit 1uses an Assist weapon at 1.0 times its normal attack power1,
and the main unit's 1hit rate increases by 20%1.
The unit targeted by a Center Attack performs the counterattack.
●Wide Attack: Your main attacks their main, and your sub attacks their sub.
The sub unit 1uses an Assist weapon at 1.2 times its normal attack power1.
Both the main and sub units counterattack a Wide Attack.
However, if the main unit counters with an ALL weapon,
the sub unit does not counterattack.
●Map Attack: Use a MAP weapon to attack every team within its area of effect.
●Each scenario has a challenge worth one point.
Its requirements are shown in Objectives.
●Earning it grants a bonus of 110,0001 funds.
●Difficulty depends on the proportion of SR Points you have earned.
Hard: You have earned SR Points in 1at least 80% of cleared stages1.
Enemy units are strengthened, among other changes that raise the difficulty.
Normal: You have earned SR Points in 1less than 80% of cleared stages1.
Funds earned from destroying enemies are 11.2 times the Hard amount1.
●If you retry after a Game Over, you cannot earn that scenario's SR Point.
●At sortie, SP is 1half its maximum value, rounded up1.
●SP 1increases by 5 each turn1.
Sub pilots recover SP in the same way.
However, SP cannot exceed its maximum.
●Quick Save in the map commands saves the current map state as suspend data.
Select Continue on the title screen, or
use Quick Continue to return to the point where you quick-saved.
See the manual for how to use Quick Continue.
●A value exclusive to Tag teams that represents the team's tension.
●Meeting either of the following conditions raises Tag Tension by 1:
11. The team's total kills pass a multiple of 2.1
12. A main pilot of a unit in the team levels up.1
●If the pilots of both units in the team are Ace Pilots,
the team starts with 1 extra Tag Tension when it sorties.
●Tag Tension reaches MAX at 2 points, making the following
unit commands available:
Maximum Break: A powerful combination attack by the main and sub units
Tag Command: Various effects, such as restoring SP
●When Tag Tension reaches MAX, the unit commands
1Maximum Break1 and 1Tag Command1 become available.
●Using either command resets Tag Tension to 0.
●1Maximum Break1: The sub and main units each freely choose a weapon
and attack the enemy in succession.
The sub unit can choose weapons other than Assist weapons.
During Maximum Break, 1the sub unit's attack1
